pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take: **Gunner, or should I say "Bubba G," what kind of mad genius schedules France against Morocco in his own lineup, ensuring he sacrifices points while sabotaging his own team play in Foxborough?** Let me tell you something, Gunner, you're on top with 68 points, but this isn't a game of Solitaire—this is the World Cup of fantasy, and you're playing like you just don't care. Balancing the elegance of France with the resilience of Morocco is a tale as old as time, but planning their mutual destruction just might be a rookie move that only you, "Bubba G," can make with such flair. Sure, France has shown brilliance, and Morocco is no pushover, but neither of these teams can save you from the dungeon of your own managerial chaos. In this bizarre matchup of self-cannibalism, I'm calling it now: France nudges it with a slim victory, but it costs you points no matter who wins. Look at me, Gunner! You're first, but it's only because everyone else is a mess. You say you're strategic; I say you're making it up as you go along. Boom!
